question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Magnify
solution:
The correct answer is: **Expand**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Magnify**: To have the power to cause objects to appear larger than they are. (बढ़ाना)

 
 
• **For example-** *I don't want to **magnify **the importance of these problems.*
 
 
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words in the options section.
 
 
• **Expand**: Become or make more significant or more extensive. (विस्तार करना)
 
 
• **For example-** *There are plans to **expand **the airport.*
 
 
 
• **Magnanimous**: Generous or forgiving, especially towards a rival or less powerful person. (उदार)
 
• **Miniature**: A thing that is much smaller than normal, especially a small replica or model. (लघुरूप)
 
• **Underemphasis**: Less emphasis than is possible or desirable. (कम जोर)
 
 
 
• From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate synonym of '**Magnify**' is '**Expand**'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.
